title: 秋の果物(粘土)
lead: 柿・梨・ぶどう・栗など、秋の果物と実りを粘土細工のタッチで12点描きました。秋のメニューや直売所の案内に使えます。
subject_en: handmade clay (plasticine) figurines of fruits: soft rounded sculpted forms with visible fingerprint-smooth surface, bright natural colours, a gentle highlight, a slightly darker clay rim at the contour acting as the closed outline, no people. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: two orange persimmons with green calyx
a bunch of purple grapes with a leaf
three chestnuts, one in a spiky burr
a red apple with a leaf
three mandarin oranges, one half peeled
a kiwi fruit cut in half beside a whole one
a small woven basket filled with mixed fruits
an acorn, a pine cone and two fallen leaves
